stellar_exploration.title: Stellar Exploration
stellar_exploration.config.title: Stellar Exploration Configuration
stellar_exploration.config.enabled.toolt: Master switch to enable or disable client-side exploration framework features.
stellar_exploration.config.always_show_x: Keep the XP bar and level visible simultaneously with the Locator Bar.
stellar_exploration.config.render_player: Render player face textures instead of generic locator waypoint dots.
stellar_exploration.config.head_size.too: Adjust the scale of rendered player heads (1 = 0.5x, 5 = 1.0x, 9 = 1.5x).
stellar_exploration.config.enable_team_b: Draw team-colored borders around player heads.
stellar_exploration.config.static_border: Hexadecimal color (#AARRGGBB) for borders when no team color is available.
stellar_exploration.config.show_player_n: Control when player names appear above heads (OFF, ALWAYS, LOOKING_AT, PLAYER_LIST).
stellar_exploration.config.show_cardinal: Display cardinal directions with Minecraft font slightly above the contextual bar.
Show Intermediate Points (NE, NW, SE, SW)
Display diagonal compass headings in subtle gray.
stellar_exploration.config.track_lodesto: Display lodestone targets as waypoints on the locator bar.
stellar_exploration.config.track_recover: Display last death location as a waypoint on the locator bar.
stellar_exploration.config.track_banner_: Display banner markers from filled maps in your inventory as waypoints on the locator bar.
stellar_exploration.config.track_normal_: Display world spawn location with a cross on the locator bar when holding a compass.
stellar_exploration.config.normal_compas: Only show spawn waypoint when holding a normal compass in main hand or off hand.
stellar_exploration.config.track_bundles: Scan nested bundles in inventory for compasses and filled maps.
stellar_exploration.config.hud_enabled.t: Toggle the exploration telemetry HUD overlay.
stellar_exploration.config.show_coordina: Display player XYZ coordinates on screen.
Display current cardinal direction and degree bearing.
stellar_exploration.config.show_dimensio: Display the current world dimension identifier.
